name: Cobot
insight: Founded in 2022 by Brad Porter, who led deployment of 500,000+ robots as Amazon's VP of robotics.
tagline: Proxie, an AI-powered mobile manipulator built for human workplaces.
description: Cobot (Collaborative Robotics) makes Proxie, a wheeled, two-armed autonomous mobile manipulator designed to move carts, totes, and boxes alongside people rather than replace them. It deliberately avoids costly bipedal humanoid designs, combining omnidirectional mobility with AI-driven situational awareness. Early customers include Maersk, Mayo Clinic, Moderna, and Owens & Minor.

modelSupport.notes: Proprietary onboard AI for perception, mobility, and manipulation.

edge: Bets on a wheeled two-armed mobile manipulator (Proxie) over costly bipedal humanoids, already piloting with Mayo Clinic, Maersk and Moderna.
pros: Practical wheeled design vs pricey humanoids

references.title: Collaborative Robotics unveils Proxie mobile manipulator
